            for i in range(0, number_of_days_back):
                date = (start_date + timedelta(days=i)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
                logMeal(self, self.base_url, "LUNCH", headers, date=date, myMeal_id=self.__class__.myMeal_idLunch)
                print(f"mealId:", self.__class__.myMeal_idLunch)

                logMeal(self, self.base_url, "DINNER", headers, date=date, myMeal_id=self.__class__.myMeal_idDinner)
                print(f"mealId:", self.__class__.myMeal_idDinner)

        deleteCreatedMeals(self, self.base_url, headers, self.__class__.myMeal_idDinner)
        deleteCreatedMeals(self, self.base_url, headers, self.__class__.myMeal_idSnacks)
